boundaries: Do not repeat completed slides experiments or create a second GitHub repository.
Keep signed stress and original displacement labels.
Use the frozen checkpoint's scaler for transfer and independent diagnostic fits; never fit transfer labels.
Independent fields and case identity are diagnostics, not novel methods or generalization results.
The exact two CADs are unseen by this Hash50 checkpoint but have historical experiment use: migration pilot, not pristine final blind test.
New strict experiments split CAD groups, fit scalers only on train, select model only on validation, and isolate final test.
Use a single GPU queue, reuse existing data, and avoid redundant audits.

phase_history.decision: PointNet global descriptor gives only0.0304percentage-point best validation improvement; compare matched wider decoder before attributing limits to geometry representation.
Widening decoder from64 to128 does not materially improve best held-out-CAD validation (~65.3%). Test target-independent query-local geometry with matched zero/actual feature slots.
Local geometry improves best validation65.2921%->63.5975%,1.6946percentage points at seed2026. Repeat same zero/actual pair with seed2027 before judging robustness.

Paired seed2027 query-local geometry: best validation64.8557%->64.0434%,gain0.8124pp. Both seeds improve case-mean/hotspot but worsen worst-case. Freeze PointNet,width128,local actual for displacement pair; final CADs/dia labels excluded.

Known-load validation u vector mean30.5837% linear vs30.0798% load-dependent; no meaningful known-load gain. Freeze both selected models before predeclared validation5 dia load-span probe. Final5CAD fields remain excluded.

Frozen val5 dia u mean28.4116% linear vs32.9928% dependent; source superposition residual0.3059%; stress87.4260%. Next predeclared train-case-relative loss addresses TOR amplitude weighting; dia does not choose new recipe and is now an observed diagnostic.
